title: Pure Rikka
summary: Pure Rikka tribute control build composed strictly of archetype members, generic Plant Xyz Monsters, and staples. By tributing Plant monsters from either side of the field, the deck activates cascading effects, searches resources, and summons powerful Plant Xyz queens.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rikka Petal adds a Rikka monster from your Deck to your hand or sends it to the GY during your Main Phase, and Special Summons itself from the GY during your opponent's End Phase while you control no monsters or only Plants.
Mudan the Rikka Fairy tributes a Plant monster to Special Summon itself from the hand, then searches any Rikka Spell or Trap card from your Deck on summon.
Rikka Princess Special Summons itself from the hand during your Main Phase, and shuffles itself from hand or GY into the Deck while tributing a Plant to negate an opponent's monster effect.
Rikka Glamour searches a Rikka monster from your Deck, and if you tributed a Plant monster to activate it, also searches another Plant monster with the same original Level but different name.

summary.title: Opening: Rikka Petal + Rikka Glamour
steps: Normal Summon Rikka Petal and activate its effect to add Mudan the Rikka Fairy from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Rikka Glamour, tributing Rikka Petal as cost to search Snowdrop the Rikka Fairy and Primula the Rikka Fairy.
Trigger Primula the Rikka Fairy in hand to Special Summon itself since a Plant monster was tributed.
Special Summon Mudan the Rikka Fairy by tributing Primula, and activate Mudan's on-summon effect to search Rikka Konkon.
Activate Rikka Konkon to Set Rikka Sheet or Rikka Tranquility directly from your Deck, enabling opponent tributes on their turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Teardrop the Rikka Queen detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to tribute 1 monster on either field, permanently growing by 200 ATK whenever a monster is tributed.

Rikka Queen Strenna adds a Plant monster or Rikka card from your GY to hand, and when tributed while possessing material, cheats out a Rank 5 or higher Plant Xyz (like Teardrop or Kanzashi) from the Extra Deck and attaches itself as material.
Kanzashi the Rikka Queen protects monsters from effect destruction by tributing a Plant monster from hand or field, and whenever a monster is tributed, revives any monster from either GY as a Plant.
Benghalancer the Resurgent provides Link-4 spot removal by returning an opponent's Special Summoned monster to the hand.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Rikka Konkon Sets a Rikka Spell or Trap directly from the Deck each turn, and once per turn lets you tribute 1 face-up monster your opponent controls instead of your own Plant to activate a Rikka effect.

Rikka Sheet targets a face-up monster to prevent it from activating effects or attacking; if a Plant was tributed on activation, it takes control of that monster until the End Phase and turns it into a Plant.
Rikka Flurries forces the opponent to tribute one of their own monsters each time you tribute a face-up Rikka monster you control.
Rikka Tranquility Special Summons a Rikka monster from your GY, and if a Plant was tributed on activation, also revives another Plant monster.

main: Rikka Petal
Starter: searches or mills a Rikka monster.
Mudan the Rikka Fairy
Tributes a Plant to summon itself; searches a Rikka Spell/Trap.
Rikka Princess
Newest: summons itself; tributes a Plant to negate a monster effect.
Snowdrop the Rikka Fairy
Tributes to summon itself and another Plant; matches Levels.
Primula the Rikka Fairy
Summons itself after a Tribute; raises Levels by 2.
Cyclamen the Rikka Fairy
Tributes itself to lower Levels by 2; returns in the End Phase.
Hellebore the Rikka Fairy
Tributes itself to negate a targeting monster effect; revives itself.
Erica the Rikka Fairy
Tributes itself for ATK; returns after a Plant is tributed.
Rikka Glamour
Tributes a Plant to search a Rikka and another Plant of the same Level.
Rikka Konkon
Newest Field Spell: Sets a Rikka Spell/Trap; lets you tribute their monster.
Rikka Flurries
Makes them tribute a monster when you tribute a Rikka.
Rikka Sheet
Locks a monster's effects, or steals it by tributing a Plant.
Rikka Tranquility
Revives a Rikka, and another Plant if you tribute.
extra: Rank 8 Plant: tributes a monster on either turn.
Rank 6 Plant: revives a monster as a Plant after a Tribute.
Rank 4 Plant: recovers a Rikka; becomes a bigger Plant Xyz when tributed.
Generic Plant Rank 8 from three: locks a Set card or flips a Plant down.
Generic Plant Rank 6 from three: bounces every other card.
Generic Plant Rank 4: recycles a Normal Trap.
Generic Plant Rank 4: destroys a weaker monster and burns.
Generic Plant Link-4: bounces a monster.
